title.narrative: Rehabilitation of the Bangui Paediatric Hospital's Neonatology Unit in Central African Republic

description.narrative: UNOPS supports mother and child care in Central African Republic and reconstruct 885 m² section of the building housing neonatology wing of the Bangui Paediatric Hospital to bring it in line with international standards. This project will improve the quality maternal and neonatal health services at the Central African Republic’s sole referral hospital for neonatal and paediatric care. \n
